about: Every place the mod touches Minecraft 1.21.1 (Mojang names). Each row is one mixin.

rows.effect: appends the Roblox pack on top of the client's resource packs (client repository only)
rows.verified: Minecraft.java lines 604 and 895 build the client resource manager from this list

rows.effect: draws the Roblox skybox over the vanilla sky dome, before sunrise, sun, moon and stars
hides Minecraft's blocky clouds while the Roblox skybox (which has its own clouds) is drawn
rows.verified: first in-game screenshot: vanilla cloud slabs cut across the Roblox sky

rows.effect: in a Melty test run only: makes a fresh creative world from the test seed, sets noon, then writes the test_checks results
